value: Do not pursue the fleeing deer; no animal interaction is needed for this work.
Whole-food air exposure is not a demonstrated preservation method. Obtain material evidence and measurement capability before preparing a comparison.

Place owned units on the ground.
Hand owned units to an adjacent actor.
Read a current-world capability contract or retained personal record.
Offer a personally tested finding or independently accept an actual nearby offer.
Give a name of up to 60 characters to this place (empty subject) or to a visible object or nearby item; naming the same subject again replaces your name for it.
Leave a mark or inscription of up to 120 characters on the ground here (empty subject) or on an object or item within reach.
Say up to 240 characters aloud; everyone living within 5 units hears it, seen or not.

candidates.function: Assess, assemble, test, use, inspect or dismantle a lever comparator: your branch beam across a stone fulcrum, a fixed seat and your own sliding reference piece. Readings give samp
Assess what a test of one named dietary constituent of your own food item needs (method, materials, equipment, controls, reader, limits), each requirement marked present, missing o

execution.progress: Assembly continues each round; an unworked round pauses it, keeping placed parts, and assemble with comparatorId resumes after rechecks. Other modes take one round.

details.costs: Study: 4 rounds, 0.5 energy each. assess (materialIds, supportIds, referenceId, sampleId, or comparatorId): 1 round, 0.2; reports each requirement met or missing. assemble: materialIds [beam: your whole untreated branch unit; optional fulcrum: your whole stone or flint unit, set where you stand on firm ground], or supportIds [a solid stone or flint object in reach], and referenceId (your non-food piece that does not decay, at most 1 unit): 3 paid rounds of 0.5, continuing; resume with assemble and comparatorId. test, compare: one reading, 1 round, 0.2, at your comparator; reading empty or loaded (sampleId: your unreserved item, at most 1 unit); approach outward or inward. inspect: 1 round, 0.2. dismantle: 1 round, 0.2. Checks run before any charge; gather, pickup and travel are separate; no refund.
details.effects: Assumed: a branch is a uniform 1.1 m beam laid at its midpoint; positions are fractions of the half-beam from the fulcrum (+ toward the reference), read to 0.02; the seat is at -0.9. A reading slides the reference until the beam tips: torques of the actual masses against stiction 0.005 m x mass on the fulcrum, so outward and inward tips bracket a null range. A test (3+ empty and 3+ loaded readings of one sample, both directions each) passes if each set repeats within 0.04 and closes; a new test replaces it. compare on a tested comparator: an empty check, 3+ loaded readings of one sample (both directions) and a closing empty check within 0.04 of the test give an endpoint: sample/reference = (null - empty null)/0.9 as an interval. A later endpoint of the same sample (followed through pickup, cutting or exposure) and reference gives after/before: decrease or increase only if it excludes 1, else inconclusive; a wet stone or flint reference adds 1%, other wet references are inconclusive. Rain voids a test; a fulcrum losing firm ground damages it. Parts keep their ids and return on dismantle. No grams, water, safety or reward.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. An entry marked inRetrieval is shown with at least the same content under the same id in this input's retrieval. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.

value.name: Air-dry food trial
value.function: Lay whole units of your own berries or roots in one layer on a clean, dry, rigid support to air-dry in actual weather, beside an equal carried untreated reference from the same stack; tend (turn or move), inspect, stop.
value.costs: Study: 3 rounds. start: inputStackId, your own unspoiled untreated whole berry or root stack with 2 x quantity whole units (default quantity 1); supportId, your own carried item with quantity whole units that is non-food, non-toxic, non-perishable, dry (water fraction 0.1 or less), rigid (contact-resistance index 8+, flexibility 0), unfractured and clean (no contamination, residue, marking or treatment record), laid on firm ordinary unobstructed ground at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your radius; or an existing food surface in reach, not another person's, of at least 0.04 x quantity area; durationRounds, default 10. One round, 1 energy. tend: within reach of the units; one round, 0.2 energy; turns them in place, or with x,y moves your support and the units to a new ground point in reach. inspect: within reach; reuses probe observe, one round and 0.2 energy. stop: one round, no energy. All checks precede any charge; gathering, travel and pickup cost separately.
value.effects: Start separates quantity treated and quantity reference units from the stack with their tenths, decay, harvest time and origin, and gives both the world food water record (assumed water fraction berry 0.85, root 0.75). The treated units lie unowned on the support over 0.04 per unit, the support item held there; the reference stays carried and reserved. Each round the existing rules apply: whole food neither evaporates nor absorbs vapour, so it never dries; rain on an uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary rate where each lies, never reset; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; contamination is not assessed. Turning changes no represented food state. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, both decays and their difference, visible shrinkage, wetness, spoilage and rain rounds, unverified; water is not measured. After durationRounds the trial ends with a comparison of your recorded readings, or indeterminate without any; spoilage, anyone taking all treated units, stop or death end it early. Ending releases the reference once and leaves the units and support lying at the site for pickup. No preservation, safety, refund or reward.

execution.progress: Each mode is one atomic round; the trial record persists and exposure continues unattended, without charge, until the interval ends, stop, removal, spoilage or death.

value.question: How can I maintain an edible reserve and reduce avoidable spoilage?
evidence: Eating two berries at tick 23 supplied 16 realized nutrition.
At tick 25 four owned berries remain, with reported decay 28.09023609; satiety is 89.5.
One stone was gathered at tick 22 and remains in inventory.
The air-dry trial contract states that whole food never dries under its represented rules.
The beam comparator contract provides relative-mass intervals and requires testing before comparisons.
Moss reports a root pressing trial and lack of a reachable heat source.
value.uncertainty: The stone's support and cutting suitability are untested. No preservation or safety benefit has been demonstrated.
value.goal: Maintain adequate food and develop honest, repeatable comparisons of food treatments.
completedSteps: Ate berries and recorded realized nutrition.
Collected one stone after a successful approach.
value.missing: Stone assessment, comparator mastery and suitable components, then tested measurements if feasible.
value.next: Observe the collected stone and study the beam comparator; use the resulting evidence to select the next trial.
value.benefit: Berry nutrition supports meal planning; recognizing the whole-food drying limitation avoids assuming preservation.

value.name: Compare prepared material samples
value.function: Take a small sample and equal reference from your own food; split or slice the sample with your stone or flint edge onto a clean support in actual weather; weigh both on your tested beam comparator; tend; stop.
value.costs: Study: 4 rounds. start: sourceItemId, your unspoiled whole berry or root stack; sampleQuantity 0.1-1 (default 0.1; over twice it must remain); durationRounds, exposure window (default 10); 1 round, 0.2 energy. prepare: preparation; toolId, your carried whole stone or flint unit with a usable edge; supportId, your clean, dry, rigid, non-toxic item (a whole unit per 0.04 covered) laid at location in reach on firm clear ground, or a food surface in reach; 1 round, 0.5. measure: measurementDeviceId, your tested beam-mass-comparator in reach, weighs the sample and the reference; 1 round, 0.2 per item. tend: in reach; location moves your support and pieces; 1 round, 0.2. stop: 1 round, 0. Checks precede any charge; travel, gathering and comparator work cost separately.
value.effects: Start separates sample and reference with tenths, decay, harvest time, origin and the world water record (assumed root 0.75, berry 0.85); both stay whole, carried, reserved. Prepare cuts the sample, taken as a 1000 kg/m3 sphere, into 2 halves or slabs of at most 5 mm laid cut face up (at least 0.04 per unit); no mass, wear or offcut; opening damage 1.1. Each round only lying cut faces exchange water: rate h/1200 x (saturation vapour density at the face - humidity x that of the air), h = 10 x (1 + 0.5 wind), face temperature from the heat balance with latent heat 2.45 MJ/kg, bounded by free water above the humidity equilibrium within 0.33 mm; rain adds 0.01 x rain x area; dry matter and nutrition stay. A weighing slides the reference both ways: mass as a reference fraction at 0.02 resolution against the tested tare; repeats give after/before and reference-adjusted intervals, a change only if 1 is excluded, else unresolved. No water content is shown. The window ends completed (weighed) or indeterminate; spoilage, removal, stop or death end it early, releasing the reference once; pieces and support stay. No preservation, safety or reward.

execution.progress: One atomic round per mode; lying cut pieces keep exchanging water unattended, without charge.
